:::{#exm-matrix-analysis}
#### Eigenvalues of a small matrix

```{r}
#| include: false
entries <- c(2, 1, 1, 2)
A <- matrix(entries, nrow = 2)
decomposition <- eigen(A)
lambda <- decomposition$values
```

The [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix}$ has the [eigenvalues](linear-algebra.qmd#def-eigenvalue)
$`{r} lambda[1]`$ and $`{r} lambda[2]`$.
Finding these eigenvalues is a question about $\matr{A}$ alone,
so it is a topic of [matrix analysis](#def-matrix-analysis).
